duration: One day a week for 8 weeks between May and August
name: Summer Volunteer Service for Students
org: Northwestern Medicine (Delnor in Geneva, Central DuPage in Winfield, Lake Forest and other suburban hospitals)
city: Geneva, Winfield, Lake Forest and other suburbs, IL
what_you_do: Volunteer one day a week for eight weeks in a hospital in the summer.
who_can_apply: Volunteers must be at least 16 years old. For Northwestern Memorial Hospital the age is 18, and it has no summer program. You must pass a health screening and an interview. You must also go to a virtual orientation.
deadline_text: 2027 summer applications are open December 1, 2026 to January 15, 2027. The 2026 summer period is closed.
how_to_apply: Fill out the volunteer application during the window. Then do an interview. Onboarding includes a health screening and an orientation. Ages 18 and up also get a background check.
notes: Volunteer offices: Delnor, 630-938-2180. Central DuPage, 630-933-6207. Lake Forest, 847-535-6851. Call the one near you.
